newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor June forwards ease, poor demand.
newsitem.headline: India castor June forwards ease, poor demand.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Tuesday eased to 1,201/1,202 rupees per quintal on sluggish overseas demand after earlier rising to 1,207/1,208 rupees, dealers said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region dropped to 4,000/5,000 bags (75 kg each) against the daily average of 25,000/30,000 bags last week.
"Traders in the major markets of Gujarat region have decided close for 3/4 days for approaching financial year end (March 31, 1997)," one operator said.
This, he said, was a traditional closure at the end of a financial year to make it possible for traders to honour their different tax liabilities.
Groundnut oil moved up from 339/340 rupees to 343/344 rupees per 10 kg on the back of limited arrivals and fresh physical support. Imported palm oil was steady at 277/278 rupees per 10 kg.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil moved up by five rupees at 525 rupees per 15 kg on increased purchases by the state-owned agencies in the Gujarat region.
